## Description

Generates HTML slides from slide_deck.md and design_spec.md. Applies theme (data-theme attribute), binds images from image-manifest.json, inserts speaker intro and contact slides, checks balance. Responds to "make HTML", "generate slides", "add images", "add speaker intro" (Korean: "HTML `만들어줘`", "`슬라이드 생성해줘`", "`이미지 넣어줘`", "`강연자 소개 추가해줘`"). Stages 5-8 of the lecture workflow.
